chapter: Life in New Orleans and tunings
title: Alternate guitar tunings
summary: He tunes many different ways without names for them and cannot read music.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young

blocks.x: I don't know who was young blood, but you know Sylvia young blood? Sylvia young blood used to live on Berkhandri Street.
Tell me about the ones that you've ever seen.
Never heard of it. Have you ever been to Walker Street and pick the end? Never think of Walker. Do you know anybody who picked with three fingers? No.
I don't see that. Have you ever seen that? Mm-hmm. Did you ever know anybody that used a different tuning? That would tune the strings different? I tune my strings different sometimes.
Yeah. How many different ways can you tune them? Oh, I don't know.
I've been in different ways. I tune a whole lot of them. Do you play a lot of your songs and different tunings from each other?
Right. What do you call the different kind of tunings?
Do you have any names for them?

Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . I know it's all that fun. I'm tuned to different ways, you know. I'm playing different ways. But I don't know one chord, one note, and I can't read something. It's never good.
You ever hear of fast-a-poole, Tony? Fast-a-poole? Spanish? Never heard of Spanish, dude.
